Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，有一个男人，他的名字是神农。他看到了有很多人不知道哪个植物好吃，也不知道什么植物对你的身体有好处。这个问题神农觉得很糟糕，所以神农去了吃每种植物。他吃了一种植物以后，就写了这个植物对你有没有好处。有的时候，神农吃了很好吃的植物。有的时候，他吃了很危险的植物。他吃完了每种植物以后，会来跟他的朋友聊到他吃的植物了。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the dangerous plant is eaten, add a physical reaction to show the danger more vividly, such as “他的肚子疼了起来。”
2. At the point where Shennong writes his notes, add his purpose or determination, such as “他想帮助人们找到能吃的植物。”
3. When he talks with his friends, include a short line of dialogue, such as “这种植物不能吃，会让人生病。”

ideas.reason: This adds a concrete, simple reaction that fits eating a dangerous plant.
His wish to help people is already clearly implied by why he starts tasting plants.
This adds fitting dialogue that gives a useful example of what he tells his friends.
